where: Couple type page (website), the nuance paragraph
current: Real depth runs in this pairing, often more than either partner shows. The risk is that the depth never surfaces, because neither of you naturally initiates the opening. Agree on who brings it back, and when. A named pattern gives you both the full space, without indefinite silence.
proposed: There is real depth in your relationship, often more than either of you shows. The risk is that your feelings never get said, because neither of you naturally starts the conversation. Try to agree on who restarts the conversation after a hard moment, and when, so you each get the space you need without a silence that has no end.
why: core: 'Agree on who brings it back'; 'the opening', 'A named pattern'
